description: Turns one phasor into five variants: reversed, two triangles and two faster cycles

inputs.text: The phasor being transformed, 0-10V; voltages outside that range wrap back into it

outputs.text: The input subtracted from 10V, so an ascending phasor comes out descending
A triangle across one input cycle, rising through the first half and falling through the second
A triangle across one input cycle, falling through the first half and rising through the second
Two complete phasor cycles for every one cycle at the input
Four complete phasor cycles for every one cycle at the input

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
